easyPrerequisites:
Shu Farmer does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Shu Farmer.
description:
Activate Shu Farmer by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's ability by paying {U}, untapping Shu Farmer.
Repeat.
